The market has priced the event at the front tenor (front_end_ratio 1.284 on a clean 20-tenor chain with zero dropped) but left the back-month wings flat (term_skew NORMAL 1.039), which on a name with a 3-of-4 EPS miss streak, ~648% scale-corrected D/E, sub-1 current ratio and an 18.96% short float arguably understates a genuinely two-tailed distribution — crash-through-support risk on a miss given the leverage, squeeze fuel on a beat given the short interest. The bear established via uw historical vrp --symbol CRWV that the name's own realised 30d vol (122.38%) exceeds its implied (104.55%) for a VRP of -0.1784 PREMIUM_BUYING, and that CRWV has been gapping 5-21% on ordinary flow with no catalyst at all — so the flat wings reflect a whole curve that has ALREADY repriced upward to match a stock trading like a meme name, not a binary-event blind spot.
